import csv,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,time
base=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
run=base/'run-001';run.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
review=pathlib.Path('/tmp/fathomdb-0829-direct/slice-60/positive-metadata-review')
manifest=json.loads((review/'manifest-v3.json').read_text())
for name in ['netns-exec.v3.sh','netns-final-exec.v3.py']:
 assert hashlib.sha256((review/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==manifest[name],name
binary=base/'target/debug/s60-manual-metadata-acceptance';assert binary.is_file()
uuid='GPU-5f9cfc90-2be1-06a7-ce39-5a6d294b209b'
def sample():
 query=subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=uuid,name,utilization.gpu,memory.free,driver_version','--format=csv,noheader,nounits'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
 apps=subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi','--query-compute-apps=gpu_uuid,pid,used_gpu_memory','--format=csv,noheader,nounits'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
 row=next([v.strip() for v in row] for row in csv.reader(query.stdout.splitlines()) if row[0].strip()==uuid)
 return {'time':time.time(),'uuid':uuid,'name':row[1],'utilization':int(row[2]),'free_mib':int(row[3]),'driver':row[4],'apps':[[v.strip() for v in row] for row in csv.reader(apps.stdout.splitlines())],'raw_gpu':query.stdout,'raw_apps':apps.stdout}
first=sample();assert first['utilization']<=5 and first['free_mib']>=20480 and first['driver']=='580.178.04' and '3090' in first['name']
assert not any(row[0]==uuid for row in first['apps'])
assert pathlib.Path('/usr/local/cuda').resolve()==pathlib.Path('/usr/local/cuda-12.6')
command=['unshare','-rUn','--','bash',str(review/'netns-exec.v3.sh'),'run',os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net'),str(binary),str(run)]
record={'command':command,'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'started':time.time(),'samples':[first],'source_sha':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'source_delta':subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],text=True),'stop':None}
with (run/'producer.stdout.log').open('wb') as out,(run/'producer.stderr.log').open('wb') as err,open(os.devnull,'rb') as null:
 child=subprocess.Popen(command,stdin=null,stdout=out,stderr=err,close_fds=True);record['launcher_pid']=child.pid
 try:
  while child.poll() is None:
   point=sample();record['samples'].append(point)
   if time.time()-record['started']>240:raise RuntimeError('owned producer watchdog exceeded240s')
   if any(row[0]==uuid and int(row[1])!=child.pid for row in point['apps']):raise RuntimeError('foreign selected-GPU allocation appeared')
   time.sleep(.05)
 except BaseException as error:
  record['stop']=repr(error);child.terminate()
  try:child.wait(timeout=15)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:child.kill();child.wait()
 finally:
  record['exit']=child.wait();record['ended']=time.time();record['samples'].append(sample())
  record['driver_primary_cuda_after']=str(pathlib.Path('/usr/local/cuda').resolve())
  record['engaged']=any(point['utilization']>0 and any(row[0]==uuid and int(row[1])==child.pid and int(row[2])>0 for row in point['apps']) for point in record['samples'])
  (run/'producer-monitor.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({key:record[key] for key in ['exit','launcher_pid','engaged','stop']},indent=2))
assert record['stop'] is None and record['exit']==0,record
assert record['engaged'],'actual selected-GPU utilization and attributable process memory not observed; no automatic retry'
assert record['driver_primary_cuda_after']=='/usr/local/cuda-12.6'
producer=json.loads((run/'producer.json').read_text());assert producer['producer_pid']==record['launcher_pid']
assert all(point['driver']=='580.178.04' for point in record['samples'])
